welcomeMessage: This website is provided as a public service by the Atherton Police Department. In an effort to protect victim privacy this website does not provide information regarding juvenile offenders, or specific information regarding calls for service and crimes that are sensitive in nature. The Department does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the information contained on this website regarding specific incidents, crimes, or people with respect to the omission of information that may have not been filed or is pending filing with a court of jurisdiction relating to criminal offenses.
mostWantedText: If you see any of the individuals listed here DO NOT take any action. Please contact the Atherton Police Department immediately at 650-688-6500 or by call 9-1-1.
missingPersonsText: The Atherton Police Department is requesting your assistance in finding the individuals listed below. If you have any information regarding their location, please contact the Atherton Police Department at 650-688-6500.
stolenVehiclesText: Please do not take direct action if you see any of the stolen vehicles listed. If you see one the the vehicles listed please contact the Atherton Police Department at 650-688-6500 or call 9-1-1.
warrantText: Do not take action if you see any of the individuals listed below. Please immediately call the Atherton Police Department at 650-688-6500.
arrestText: Using this website, members of the public will have access to public information regarding individuals arrested by Atherton Police Department. Unless otherwise declared "guilty" or "convicted", arrestees are considered innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
vacationCheckDisclaimer: Are you going out of the area? Upon your request, the Atherton Police Department will provide a check of your property during times when your residence is vacant due to business or vacation trips. Note: The Atherton Police Department and the Town do not assume any liability for loss or damage to property during the specified dates.
vacationCheckAdditionalInfoInstructions: Please let us know the days of the week you expect gardeners, pool services, cleaning services, etc., and any additional information that might be useful (cars that will be parked, animals on site, etc.)
vacationCheckSuccessText: Your vacation home check request was successfully submitted to Atherton Police Department.
securityCameraDisclaimer: The Atherton Police Department surveillance camera registry allows residents to voluntarily register their surveillance cameras with the Police Department. Police will not have access to the camera systems, but will be aware that a camera exists when investigating a crime in or around their neighborhood.
securityCameraAdditionalInfoInstructions:
Be specific in the additional information field. Describe where cameras are located and what is captured. This will save us and you time if we are investigating a crime in your neighborhood.

Example: Outdoor camera over driveway views sidewalk and parts of Fair Oaks Ln.
securityCameraSuccessText: Your security camera registration request was successfully submitted to Atherton Police Department.
stopDataStatsDisclaimer: The data presented below is based on officers' perceptions of stopped individuals.
stopDataStatsDefinitions:
1. Stops: A stop is any interaction between someone and a police officer, in which the officer detains the person or conducts a search - including pedestrian and vehicle stops.
  2. Location: Atherton police officers patrol Atherton, CA.
  3. Race of Ethnicity (Perceived): These race and ethnicity categories are defined by RIPA. The officer reports their perception of people they stop in these categories: White, Hispanic/Latino, Black/African American, Asian, Middle Eastern or South Asian, or Pacific Islander.
  4. Circumstances of the Stop: Was the stop a result of a call for service? If no, then the stop is deemed "officer initiated."
  5. Reason for Stop - Reasonable Suspicion: When the reason for a stop is categorized as "reasonable suspicion of a person involved in criminal activity," then the officer also selects from sub-categories: Actions indicative of casing, Carrying suspicious object, Indicative of engaging in violent crime, Matched suspect description, Officer witness (officer witnessed commission of a crime), Other (other reasonable suspicion), or Witness identification (witness or victim identification of suspect at scene).
  6. Reason for Stop - Traffic Violation: When the reason for a stop is categorized as "traffic violation," then the officer also selects from these sub-categories: moving violation, equipment violation and non-moving violation.
  7. Result of Stop: Potential results of a stop include Warning, No Action, Citation for Infractions, Psychiatric Hold, Noncriminal/Car Transport, In-Field Cite and Release, Field Interview Card Completed or Custodial Arrest without Warrant.
